QuestInfo.name: Gwin's Tale
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator says that she has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: You should take the Maple Administrator's advice and talk to Gwin, who started his adventures alongside the very first adventurers in Maple World. Take 1 #bDrake's Blood#k and #bgo see Gwin#k who is somewhere in Victoria's Central Dungeon.
QuestInfo.2: Gwin, who was one of the first adventurers in Maple World, has yet to stop adventuring. You gave him a Drake's Blood and received his tale in return.

1.0: Ah... Is this the end...?#b\r\n#L0#Are you alright, Gwin?#l
1.1: Who's there? This is a dangerous place... #b\r\n#L0#I've traveled far just to hear your stories.#l
1.2: My tales...? Meh... Look at me, I'm pathetic. I've run of out items.#b\r\n#L0#I've brought some things for you.#l
1.3: Oh, this is Drake's Blood! With this item, I'll be able to survive here for at least a month! Thank you. Did you say you've come to hear my stories? I can't talk long since I haven't found what I'm here to find, but I'll give you this. This is my documentation of everything that has happened to me.

yes.0: I better power up! My adventure hasn't come to an end yet.

npc.0: Find Gwin, who has embarked on an adventure in the central dungeon of Victoria Island.

item.0: Ah, I've run out of items... It would be great if I just had 1 #bDrake's Blood#k...

0.0: It's been tough collecting the tales I've requested, hasn't it? Let me inform you of one thing that might help you, #h0#. Maple World is filled with experienced heroes and they have more stories to tell than anyone else in the world.
0.1: Tales you acquire from them will be extremely valuable. How about finding #bGwin#k, who has set out to travel the central dungeon of Victoria?

yes.0: Gwin went on a new adventure to the central dungeon of Victoria but has not yet returned. He must be running out of items by now... Will you take him #b1 Drake's Blood#k and show your support, #h0#? Surely, it would help him a lot.

no.0: It would be helpful to hear Gwin's tales.
